::: {#def-data-matrix}

#### Data matrix and outcome vector

The **data matrix** $\mpredvar$ of a [data set](#def-data-set) $\dataset$ stacks the $\nobs$ inputs $\vpredvar_i$ as rows,
with one column for each of the $\inputdim$ input variables.
The **outcome vector** $\voutvar$ stacks the $\nobs$ outcomes:

$$
\mpredvar = \begin{bmatrix}
  \tp{\vpredvar_1} \\
  \vdots \\
  \tp{\vpredvar_{\nobs}}
\end{bmatrix},
\qquad
\voutvar = \begin{bmatrix} \outvar_1 \\ \vdots \\ \outvar_{\nobs} \end{bmatrix} .
$$ {#eq-data-matrix}

Row $i$ of $\mpredvar$ and entry $i$ of $\voutvar$ together are the $i$-th pair of the data set,
so $\mpredvar$ and $\voutvar$ hold the same information as $\dataset$ in a tabular form.

:::
